name: Ludwik
source:
"Princess! Can I do anything for you!? I'll do anything if it's for your sake. You don't need to hold back, give me any orders you like!"

A hunting dog that came to Rozum castle four years ago.
He wasn't attached to his violent master and one time when his master was being rough with him the princess Julia saved him.
He's quite wary and doesn't warm up to strangers, but he swore loyalty to Julia who he accepts as his new master.
When it comes to Julia he has a bad habit to act without thinking of the consequences.
